Keep in mind that you can actually block entire ranges of IPs, which might help in quickly blocking more than one bad user until you can finish individually blocking everyone.

If you want to buy even more time at the cost of locking out legit edits for a time, you can also temporarily change user group permissions so only admins can edit anything at all until you're done, do all the blocking and deleting and reverting you need to do, then change things back.

Also, I might recommend switching to account confirmation, which might make things easier in that then the user does all the work of creation while you just confirm it once you're certain they're legit.
